title: RBI Digital Payments Index (RBI-DPI) stands at 516.76 for Sept 2025
theme: RBI Digital Payments Index (RBI-DPI) stands at 516.76 for Sept 2025
attentionJustification: Enforceable regulatory circular issued by RBI/SEBI/DICGC.

constituentArticles.title: RBI Digital Payments Index (RBI-DPI) stands at 516.76 for Sept 2025
constituentArticles.text: RBI-DPI (base March 2018=100) rose to 516.76 in Sept 2025 from 493.22 in March 2025. 5 parameters: Payment Enablers (25%), Infra Demand (10%), Infra Supply (15%), Performance (45%), Centricity (5%).
